basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast and avid gamer from Seattle, Washington. I work as a software engineer at a mid-sized tech firm. In my free time, I enjoy exploring new games, building custom PCs, and sharing my adventures on Reddit. I am single and often online during late evenings and weekends. My interests include technology trends, gaming strategies, and the latest gadget reviews.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My knowledge is primarily in software development, but I've self-taught myself about hardware through building custom PCs and participating in online tech communities.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: I am highly familiar with Reddit and subreddit-specific rules and adhere strictly to them. I actively report posts that violate community guidelines and participate in discussions that promote a respectful and informative environment.
